summary: 6 live two-sided disagreements (of 37,582 issued queries), ALL in the single direction (Lean omega = NOT_PROVEN, z3 = ENTAILED). Investigated per C4.
cause: Lean's `omega` TACTIC practical incompleteness on large LIA goals. Verified standalone (single goal, max_batch=1, 300s, no batch/truncation effects): on the EXACT same facts/goal objects that z3 receives, `by intros; omega` fails and Lean error-recovers with sorryAx (-> correctly classified NOT_PROVEN by the axiom whitelist). z3 (a complete SMT decision procedure for linear integer arithmetic) proves the entailment (facts and not-goal UNSAT). Same facts feed both deciders, so this is NOT an encoding mismatch.
soundness: SOUND direction. omega failing -> NOT_PROVEN is conservative: it can only keep a (really redundant) record, never delete a true theorem and never emit a false PROVEN. Confirmed: dangerous_false_positive_candidates = 0 (no PROVEN that z3 refutes).
impact_on_judgments: NONE. These 6 are C3 usability sub-queries. The reported M1=20, M2=299/299, C3=228/231 match v1.4.7 EXACTLY (per_judgment_disagree over the 550 M1+C3 judgments = 0). v1.4.7 used the same Lean omega, so the same conservatism is present in both and changes no reported number.
characteristics: 29-70 hypotheses over all 11 base integer invariants; goals are linear combinations with mixed-sign coefficients (e.g. 3*alpha - 2*diam + 2*radius >= 5).
